export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/hcl-technologies-limited) shows 13,923 records, but the visible rows are IMPORTS into India, e.g. "2026-02-28 | MOUSER ELECTRONICS INC | HCL TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED | AMPHENOL POSITRONIC DSUB 78F PCB STR Z G / D-SUB HIGH DENSITY CONNECTORS (ACTUAL USER) | MANSFIELD, UNITED STATES | CHENNAI AIR CARGO ACC INMAA4, India | 85366910 | BOL 7805321" — i.e. HCL as consignee, not shipper. No outbound export B/L with date, destination and HS code was visible on any free page; volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403, so export-side rows seen = 0. Declared HS 847130 (portable computers) is not corroborated by any observed shipment line: the only HS codes actually seen are 85366910, 85369010 and 85389000 (connectors/terminals), all on the import side.
domestic_evidence: HCLTech investor page (https://www.hcltech.com/investors) states: "Revenue INR Revenue of ₹35,620 Crores, up 3.0% QoQ & up 11.5% YoY" and "Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending September 2026 totaled $14.8B" — a listed, audited-revenue company (BSE/NSE: "₹ 1,423.80 INR ... November 27, 2026"), so domestic and global supply of IT services is real and financially documented. Note: this is services revenue, not a goods-supply GST/tender record; no GeM/CPPP contract line was retrieved within the call budget.
note: Large listed Indian IT-services company (HCL Technologies Limited, Noida; BSE/NSE listed). Fact-check per Rule 5: (a) export shipments — NOT confirmed. The only customs evidence found is inbound: 13,923 import records on ImportKey, latest 2026-02-28, HCL as buyer of electronic components from Mouser/DigiKey etc. No export B/L with date, destination, HS and B/L number was seen; export-side sources (volza, eximpedia, trademo) were blocked (403), so export_status = declared_only at best, and strictly 'no export shipment line found'. (b) domestic — confirmed via published consolidated revenue (₹35,620 Cr in Q2 FY27, $14.8B LTM to Sep 2026) and stock-exchange listing; this is services revenue, not goods turnover, and no GST band or tender record was retrieved. HS 847130 is not supported by any observed record — the company's actual customs activity is component imports under 85366910/85369010/85389000; per Rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, code should be corrected to the factual activity. Source counter: ImportKey page claims 13,923 shipments; rows actually visible in the free view = 5 import rows (plus supplier/buyer aggregate tables). No CIN/PAN quoted because none was verified from a public registry within the call budget.
